savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: 1-201. Nothing in this Order shall be deemed to terminate or otherwise affect the appointment, or to require the reappointment, of any occupant of any position listed in Section 1-1 of this Order who was the occupant of that position immediately prior to the issuance of this Order.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Protects the appointment of the occupant of any position listed in sec. 1-1 of EO 12154 who held it immediately before. It does not name EO 12076; positions of EO 12076 that EO 12154 re-lists (for example the Senior Adviser to the Secretary of State, the ADAMHA Administrator, the PBGC Executive Director) keep their incumbents, positions it omits lose their placement.

transfer_provisions.quote: 1-101. The following positions are placed in level IV of the Executive Schedule:
transfer_provisions.note: Re-places eight positions in level IV and four in level V; a carry-forward of placements, not a transfer of a function or property.

effective_date_reading: No effective-date wording; sec. 1-202 says 'is hereby revoked', so the revocation of EO 12076, as amended, took effect on signing, 1979-09-04 (printed 44 FR 51965, September 6, 1979).

targets_in_batch_08.EO:12076: sec. 1-202 ('Executive Order No. 12076, as amended, is hereby revoked'): whole order including its amendments by EO 12099, 12111 and 12119, no qualifier, no exception.

conclusion: EO 12154 (signed 1979-09-04, 44 FR 51965, read once in full) places eight positions in level IV and four in level V, protects incumbents of the positions it lists (sec. 1-201) and revokes EO 12076, as amended (sec. 1-202). The revocation is unqualified and took effect on signing. The only continuity provision (sec. 1-201) is limited to positions that EO 12154 itself lists.
